sources.title: Thermodynamics of 4D Dilatonic Black Holes and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: How do four-derivative corrections change extremal Einstein–Maxwell–dilaton black-hole masses and entropies, and under which UV assumptions do the resulting Wilson-coefficient conditions support the weak WGC?

sources.title: Duality and Supersymmetry Constraints on the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Can duality symmetries inherited from the UV make positivity bounds or the null energy condition sufficient for the mild WGC in Einstein-Maxwell-dilaton-axion theory, and how does additional supersymmetry constrain extremality corrections?

sources.title: Causality, unitarity, and the weak gravity conjecture

evidence.text: Under what assumptions do causality and unitarity constrain higher-derivative corrections to black-hole extremality so that black holes themselves can supply the superextremal states required by the weak gravity conjecture?

sources.title: Higher derivative corrections to black brane thermodynamics and the weak gravity conjecture

evidence.text: Under what conditions do leading higher derivative corrections lower extremal black p-brane tension-to-charge ratios, allowing large branes to satisfy the WGC bound, and how is this related to microcanonical entropy corrections and scattering positivity?

sources.title: Higher-order corrections to mass-charge relation of extremal black holes

evidence.text: Is the observed negative extremal-mass correction universal in quantum gravity, or does another background furnish a counterexample? Suggested tests include non-supersymmetric type II Calabi-Yau black holes and black branes, neither of which is computed here.

sources.title: Thermodynamics of 4D Dilatonic Black Holes and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Forward-amplitude factorization in a spinning-polynomial basis supplies conditional positivity bounds. UV examples are studied by tree-level neutral-field matching, charged-particle loop estimates, and string effective-action reduction.

sources.title: Duality and Supersymmetry Constraints on the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: For O(d,d), evaluate the null contraction of the stress tensor on the equal-charge spherical background, retaining implicit corrections to the two-derivative contribution. Supersymmetric amplitude relations separately constrain coefficients for fields in gravity and vector multiplets.

sources.title: Causality, unitarity, and the weak gravity conjecture

evidence.text: The paper uses the imported extremality/on-shell-action relation and reports explicit comparisons with perturbed metrics for quartic curvature and dilatonic examples. Massive-scalar tree-level matching illustrates cancellations among individually sign-indefinite operators.

sources.title: Higher derivative corrections to black brane thermodynamics and the weak gravity conjecture

evidence.text: At first order in the higher derivative couplings, evaluate the correction action on the Einstein solution at fixed temperature and potential. The background equations and vanishing boundary variation for q≥2 eliminate the need to compute the corrected solution explicitly.

sources.title: Higher-order corrections to mass-charge relation of extremal black holes

evidence.text: The imported construction reduces operators by field redefinitions, fixes invariant coefficients from heterotic input, and fixes c through consistency with a cited exact result. The present paper uses the resulting fields to extract an additional asymptotic scalar charge.

sources.title: Thermodynamics of 4D Dilatonic Black Holes and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: A regulated Euclidean action includes the Gibbons–Hawking–York boundary term and flat-space subtraction. It computes G = M − TS − QeΦ in an ensemble fixing temperature, electric potential and magnetic charge; entropy is interpreted as Wald entropy after corrections.

sources.title: The Weak Gravity Conjecture and the Viscosity Bound with Six-Derivative Corrections

evidence.text: Can leading and next-to-leading higher-derivative corrections make the downward extremal mass-to-charge correction associated with the WGC compatible with the KSS viscosity bound for charged AdS5 black branes?

sources.title: Higher-order corrections to mass-charge relation of extremal black holes

evidence.text: Do higher-derivative effects lower the extremal mass at fixed gauge charge and produce repulsion? These are separate tests when additional massless fields contribute attractive forces, so the dynamical-dilaton example requires both mass and scalar-charge corrections.

sources.title: Proof of the Weak Gravity Conjecture from Black Hole Entropy

evidence.text: Under what assumptions do higher-dimension operators increase black-hole entropy at fixed mass and charge, and can the resulting coefficient bounds enforce a positive extremality shift and the weak gravity conjecture?

sources.title: The Weak Gravity Conjecture, RG Flows, and Supersymmetry

evidence.text: Do one-loop RG flows make higher-derivative extremality corrections positive for sufficiently massive dyonic black holes, thereby satisfying the mild WGC? How do additional massless fields and N≥2 supersymmetric couplings change that conclusion?

sources.title: Scalar quasinormal modes in Reissner-Nordström black holes: implications for Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: How do four-derivative Einstein–Maxwell EFT operators shift massless scalar zero-damping modes of nearly extremal Reissner–Nordström black holes, and does an adopted QNM causality criterion select the same Wilson-coefficient combination as the black-hole Weak Gravity Conjecture?

sources.title: Entropy Bounds on Effective Field Theory from Rotating Dyonic Black Holes

evidence.text: What field-basis invariant constraints on four-dimensional Einstein-Maxwell EFT follow from positive classical Wald-entropy corrections for thermodynamically stable rotating dyonic black holes, and how do these constraints affect extremality and black-hole decay?

sources.title: Stability of Extremal Black Holes and Weak Cosmic Censorship Conjecture in Kiselev Spacetime

evidence.text: How do small cosmological-constant-related perturbations affect extremal black-hole thermodynamics and WGC-based stability, and does charged-scalar scattering preserve entropy increase and weak cosmic censorship in quantum-corrected RN-AdS Kiselev spacetime?

sources.title: Quantum gravitational corrections to Reissner-Nordström black hole thermodynamics and their implications for the weak gravity conjecture*

evidence.text: Do nonlocal one-loop effects of massless fields lower the mass of RN black holes at fixed charge, produce the superextremal states relevant to the WGC, and relate that shift to thermodynamic stability and logarithmic entropy corrections?

sources.title: Weak Gravity Conjecture, Central Charges and $\eta/s$

evidence.text: Does an assumed AdS weak gravity conjecture constrain higher-derivative couplings sufficiently to enforce the KSS bound at extremality, and how do these constraints interact with holographic central-charge bounds?

sources.title: Higher-Derivative Corrections to Reissner--Nordström Black Holes from Worldline QFT

evidence.text: How do four-derivative curvature–Maxwell couplings modify electrically charged Reissner–Nordström geometry, extremality and entropy, and can worldline QFT recover these corrections and support shadow constraints?

sources.title: Higher-Derivative Corrections to Entropy and the Weak Gravity Conjecture in Anti-de Sitter Space

evidence.text: How do four-derivative interactions change AdS-Reissner-Nordström extremality and microcanonical entropy, and what Wilson-coefficient constraints follow if entropy corrections are positive for thermodynamically stable black holes?

sources.title: Derivative corrections to extremal black holes with moduli

evidence.text: How do higher-derivative operators change the fixed-charge mass, entropy and long-range self-force of large extremal black holes with moduli, and are the three corrections correlated in ways relevant to the WGC and RFC?

sources.title: Repulsive black holes and higher-derivatives

evidence.text: How do four-derivative corrections change the long-range static force between extremal black holes with massless scalars, and when do superextremality and self-repulsion impose different conditions?

sources.title: Force-free higher derivative Einstein-Maxwell theory and multi-centered black holes

evidence.text: Which four-derivative Einstein–Maxwell interactions admit static multicentered extremal black holes with position-independent energy, and are their force-free constraints stronger than preservation of the extremal mass–charge ratio?

sources.title: The weak gravity conjecture in the Vilkovisky-DeWitt effective action of quantum gravity

evidence.text: What leading quantum-gravitational correction does the Vilkovisky–DeWitt effective action predict for the extremal Reissner–Nordström mass–charge relation when both local and nonlocal operators are retained, and how can this inform a weak-gravity diagnostic?

sources.title: Deformations of extremal black holes and the UV

evidence.text: Do UV corrections controlling marginal tidal deformations of extremal charged black holes indicate EFT failure, or faithfully reproduce UV physics? Can their signs motivate gravitational consistency bounds beyond the asymptotically flat weak gravity conjecture (WGC)?

sources.title: α′-corrections to near extremal dyonic strings and weak gravity conjecture

evidence.text: Can higher-derivative corrections to near-extremal forces provide a WGC-motivated consistency criterion when supersymmetry protects the extremal mass-to-charge ratio? How does the answer depend on the thermodynamic quantities held fixed?
